witnesses.name: proof_of_AllocId_return_wit_1
witnesses.strategy: Pattern ALLOCATE (high risk, single independent final-result group): select the success disjunct. Let b=Znth index bytes 0 and destruct allocid_entry_scan_inv to obtain offset, id=index*8+offset, entry=shiftr b offset, lower bits true, and 0<=offset<=8. From byte range, b<>255 and byte_eq_255_of_low_bits derive offset<8. Use land entry 1=0 and shiftr/testbit to prove bit offset is false; div8_add_offset/mod8_add_offset identify id/8=index and id mod 8=offset (normalize C quot/rem with id>=0). Earlier IDs are set by splitting their quotient before index versus in the same byte below offset, using allocid_index_scan_inv, Ztestbit_255_low and id_map_bytes_ok_query_eq. This proves idmanager_min_free_id. Instantiate store_id_map in store_idmanager_allocated_unlinked with the displayed replace_Znth index updated_byte bytes. Normalize unsigned_last_nbits of b and the one-bit shift using byte range and 0<=offset<8. Prove id_map_bytes_ok for idlist_add id old_ids: length by replacement, Forall byte bounds by OR bit bounds, list validity/NoDup by id being free, and each membership/testbit equation by splitting query=id, different byte, or same byte/different bit (same_div8_mod8_neq and Ztestbit_1_neq0). Use proof-local assertions, no new helper declarations. Fold OSHeap through the transport definitions/crtos_heap_lift_sep, instantiate the updated bytes, and cancel unchanged id_max/hoffset/id_map/htable fields and original bucket heap. Buckets retain old idlist validity because the allocated bit is deliberately unlinked; no node ownership is manufactured.

split_strategies.proof_of_AllocId_entail_wit_5_split_goal: Pattern ENTRY_SCAN: use id_map_bytes_ok_Znth_range with the loop index bounds for 0<=b<=255. Unfold allocid_entry_scan_inv; instantiate offset=0 and id=index*8. shiftr b 0=b, bounds are linear, and the quantified lower-bit range is empty. Pure target, no resource updates.

split_strategies.proof_of_AllocId_entail_wit_6_split_goal: Pattern ENTRY_SCAN (high risk): destruct old invariant and instantiate offset+1. The old byte range plus lower-bit clause and b<>255 exclude offset=8 via byte_eq_255_of_low_bits, so offset+1<=8. From entry=shiftr b offset and land entry 1<>0 derive testbit b offset=true; append this bit to the old lower-bit prefix. Use shiftr composition to identify shiftr entry 1=shiftr b (offset+1), prove this is in 0..255, and remove unsigned_last_nbits at width 8. Prove updated id range by lia. Only a pure target; establish needed facts as proof-local assertions, no new helper.

witnesses.name: proof_of_AllocId_return_wit_2
witnesses.strategy: Pattern FULL: choose the -1/full disjunct. For any 0<=j<idmax, use id>=idmax and entry-scan invariant to show j<id=index*8+offset. If j/8<index, index-scan invariant gives byte=255 and Ztestbit_255_low gives query=true. Otherwise j is in the selected byte and j mod 8<offset, so the lower-bit clause gives query=true; use id_map_bytes_ok_query_eq. This proves idmanager_full without requiring padding bits set. Fold store_idmanager with the original bytes and idbuckets_ok, transporting the unchanged six heap components under OSHeap using definitions/crtos_heap_lift_sep. No bitmap update or node transfer.
